entry.name: Binh Pham
entry.department: Instrument Controls and Data Science Department

evidence.currentRole: https://inl.elsevierpure.com/en/persons/binh-pham/ — “Binh Pham is a data analyst in the Instrument Controls and Data Science Department at Idaho National Laboratory.” The employer describes ongoing scientific analysis of TRISO fuel experiments, statistical detection of instrument failures, and quantitative simulation research. Current employer-linked output includes 2026 reactor and sensor-monitoring research. This is a career scientific data-analysis appointment rather than a trainee position; the linked ORCID records continuous INL employment since 2008.
evidence.doctorateOrPapers: https://inl.elsevierpure.com/en/persons/binh-pham/ — employer biography and education section explicitly identify a PhD in Electronic Engineering from Moscow Power Engineering Institute. phdYear deliberately omitted: employer education gives a February 1993 award date, whereas linked ORCID https://orcid.org/0000-0001-6695-6150 records completion in June 1992. The doctorate itself is consistently documented. Employer profile also lists peer-reviewed reactor research in 2024 and 2026.
evidence.vietnameseSignal: Vietnamese given name Binh with surname Pham, explicitly published on the official INL profile: https://inl.elsevierpure.com/en/persons/binh-pham/. No diacritics or expanded middle name reconstructed.
evidence.dedup: Ran npm run find-roster-matches -- "Binh Pham" --url https://inl.elsevierpure.com/en/persons/binh-pham/ --url https://orcid.org/0000-0001-6695-6150 ; output: no roster or retired-id matches. gh issue list --state all --search '"Binh Pham"' returned closed #1080 (https://github.com/dynaroars/vietprofs/issues/1080); checked its body/comments: that hit concerns Thai Binh Pham, a UCI mosquito/CRISPR researcher, not this INL electronic-engineering PhD. No matching INL candidate in that issue.

evidence.currentRole: https://tintphan.wixsite.com/academics — “I am a staff scientist in Theoretical Biology and Biophysics at Los Alamos National Laboratory”. His maintained October 2026 CV (https://71161e2f-bb90-45d5-b13d-3c9f33d9ab00.filesusr.com/ugd/90b8bd_123cfbffe3d84d03807c6243fc84d446.pdf?index=true), linked from https://tintphan.wixsite.com/academics/resume, specifies a career staff appointment beginning June 2025, following postdoctoral service ending that month. It gives Los Alamos, New Mexico as his work address. Employer-published identity corroboration: https://laro.lanl.gov/esploro/profile/tin_phan names Tin Thien Phan and links ORCID 0000-0001-9998-8263. That employer page is a publication profile without an appointment title, so the proposed verification source is the maintained personal site and confirmed is false; do not upgrade confirmation on publication affiliation alone.
evidence.doctorateOrPapers: October 2026 CV, page 1: https://71161e2f-bb90-45d5-b13d-3c9f33d9ab00.filesusr.com/ugd/90b8bd_123cfbffe3d84d03807c6243fc84d446.pdf?index=true — PhD in applied mathematics at Arizona State University, August 2016–July 2021. Same CV distinguishes staff employment from the preceding postdoctoral appointments. Independently, employer profile https://laro.lanl.gov/esploro/profile/tin_phan and publications identify the same researcher through ORCID and viral-dynamics coauthors.
evidence.vietnameseSignal: https://news.asu.edu/20160509-asu-grad-mathematics-something-i-am-meant-do — ASU's profile explicitly identifies Tin Phan as originally from Quy Nhon, Vietnam. The employer profile supplies the fuller name Tin Thien Phan; no Vietnamese diacritics inferred.
evidence.dedup: Ran npm run find-roster-matches -- "Tin Thien Phan" with every identity URL: LANL profile, personal homepage, resume page, linked CV PDF, and https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9998-8263 ; output: no roster or retired-id matches. Earlier run with the LANL profile also returned no matches. gh issue list --state all --search '"Tin Phan"' returned closed #1045 (https://github.com/dynaroars/vietprofs/issues/1045). Its audit rejected the earlier proposal because only personal staff claims/publication affiliations were available and explicitly allowed a later evidence-backed proposal. This output preserves that history and remains unconfirmed; the October 2026 CV now documents the June 2025 staff conversion precisely. No new GitHub issue was created.
